column3: Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “the raging of His voice” is rendered “the thunder of His voice.”
Close to the Hebrew; “His light” is rendered “His lightning.”
NASB supplies “the lightnings” as the object of “He does not restrain.”
“Wonders” is rendered as the adverb “wondrously,” and “we do not know” as “which we cannot comprehend.”
The Hebrew has “earth” without “on” and “the downpour of rains of His strength”; NASB renders the second line “to the downpour and the rain, ‘Be strong.’”
“He puts a seal on the hand” is rendered “He seals the hand,” and “all the people of His work” as “all men may know His work.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“From the chamber” is rendered “Out of the south,” and “from the scattering winds” as “out of the north.”
“It gives ice” is rendered “ice is made,” and “in constraint” as “frozen.”
“The cloud of His light” is rendered “the cloud of His lightning.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the world, the earth” is rendered “the inhabited earth.”
“For a rod” is rendered “for correction,” and “covenant loyalty” as “lovingkindness”; “He makes it find” is rendered “He causes it to happen.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“When” is rendered “how,” and “the light of His cloud” as “the lightning of His cloud.”
“The balancings of the clouds” is rendered “the layers of the thick clouds”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “wind” after “south.”
Close to the Hebrew; “clouds” is rendered “skies.”
NASB supplies “our case” after “We cannot arrange.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “in the clouds” is rendered “in the skies.”
“Gold” is rendered “golden splendor,” and “on God” as “Around God.”
Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “He does not see” is rendered “He does not regard.”
